swimming_pool.evidence: The only pool visible, at the lower left, is on a neighboring lot outside the yellow outline.

detached_structure.evidence: A small light-colored structure, possibly a shed, sits at the top edge of the outline near the northwest corner. It is partly obscured by trees.

signals.notes: The house is heavily shaded by mature trees, with dry, patchy lawn to the northwest and northeast and dense canopy to the south and east. The roof is dark and partly shadowed, so its condition is hard to judge, and no driveway is visible within the outline.
